Title: Data Engineer - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
Industries: Banking, IT Services and IT Consulting, and Retail
Description: Who You'll Work With Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward. In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else. When you join us, you will have: Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey. A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family. Your Impact You will build the foundational data infrastructure that powers cutting-edge AI applications leveraging LLMs, retrieval systems, workflows, and emerging agentic architectures. You will design and maintain scalable data pipelines, manage secure data environments, and prepare data for AI-driven systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams and clients. You’ll tackle real-world challenges by contributing to the development of next-generation AI systems and grow as a technologist by working alongside diverse experts across industries. You will design and build the scalable, reproducible data components essential for machine learning, agentic, and autonomous AI systems. You’ll assess data landscapes, apply data quality fundamentals, and prepare data for AI solutions. Additionally, you’ll learn to translate simple hypotheses into engineered features, manage secure data environments, and contribute to R&D initiatives focused on innovating and scaling next-generation AI capabilities. Your work will help solve some of the most complex and high-impact challenges facing clients across industries. Collaborating across QuantumBlack and QuantumBlack Labs teams, you’ll help develop innovative AI capabilities and scalable enterprise solutions. You’ll help build robust data foundations for scalable, production-ready AI systems. Your contributions will directly support the firm’s ability to accelerate AI adoption, solve complex business problems at scale, and enable clients to achieve meaningful, lasting impact. You’ll be based in Monterrey as part of our global Data Engineering community. Working in cross-functional Agile teams, you’ll collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and industry experts to deliver AI solutions. By partnering with clients from data owners to C-level executives you’ll help solve complex problems that drive tangible business value and begin to build your skills as a client-facing technologist. You will have a unique opportunity to grow at the forefront of AI, data engineering, and emerging agentic technologies. You’ll develop expertise at the intersection of technology and business by tackling diverse challenges in the evolving AI landscape. Working alongside multidisciplinary teams, you’ll gain a holistic understanding of how data engineering enables advanced AI while collaborating with some leading AI and data experts in the industry. Your Qualifications and Skills Degree in Computer Science/Engineering, or equivalent experience 2+ years’ experience in a data-focused role (internships, academic projects) Ability to write clean, well-documented code in a modern programming language, with a strong preference for Python and SQL Interest in or exposure to data engineering in the context of Agentic AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Business Intelligence across different types of data formats (structured vs unstructured) and processing methods (streaming vs batch) Familiarity with commonly used data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, PSQL, etc.), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and engineering tools (Pandas, Spark, dbt, LangChain, etc.) Exposure to modern software development practices, including version control (Git) and foundational concepts in DevOps and MLOps/LLMOps and CI/CD principles Exceptional time management in a complex and largely autonomous work environment Willingness to learn quickly and adapt to different project situations and tech stacks Experience using coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc.) is a plus Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and Spanish

Conectamos tecnología, infraestructura y personas para hacer posible una mejor forma de movernos. Nos mueve hacer que más personas y empresas puedan dar el paso hacia la movilidad eléctrica. Todos los días integramos soluciones y acompañamiento para resolver los retos de esa transición, con las personas al centro de lo que construimos. Y queremos que seas parte. ¿Qué buscamos? Un perfil analítico con mentalidad de negocio, capaz de ligar las métricas de growth con los resultados de cada unidad de negocio. Buscamos a alguien que construya la atribución de punta a punta, automatice todo reporte manual y aplique IA para que el equipo escale. ¿Cuál será tu misión? Ser el motor analítico y de automatización de Growth. Convertirás datos dispersos de ads, web y CRM en un sistema que optimice hacia las etapas clave del funnel, no solo hacia leads. Tus principales responsabilidades serán: Construir la atribución full-funnel uniendo Meta, Google, GA4 y Microsoft Dynamics 365, y calcular unit economics por línea de negocio y canal. Analizar funnels de ciclo largo por cohorte y diseñar experimentos con rigor estadístico para encontrar fugas y oportunidades de negocio. Automatizar, junto con BI, los pipelines de datos y los reportes recurrentes de Growth, incluyendo alertas sobre KPIs clave. Implementar offline conversions en Meta y Google Ads para que los algoritmos optimicen hacia clientes reales. Ser dueño/a del catálogo de métricas de Growth y reconciliar las cifras entre plataformas para que cada número sea trazable. Aplicar IA con agentes y flujos de LLMs para automatizar análisis, detectar anomalías y analizar información no estructurada del CRM y WhatsApp. Requisitos básicos: 1 a 3 años de experiencia en growth analytics, revenue ops, BI o data analytics SQL avanzado: joins complejos, window functions, CTEs y modelado de tablas Python para análisis de datos, consumo de APIs y scripts programados Dominio de unit economics y análisis de cohortes en funnels de ciclo largo Experiencia diseñando y dimensionando experimentos Experiencia real usando LLMs para automatizar análisis o procesos Dashboards en Looker Studio, Power BI o similar Deseable experiencia en compañías de alto crecimiento: tech, movilidad, fintech o leasing. Habilidades clave: Mentalidad de negocio : traduces métricas en impacto económico. Comunicación ejecutiva : explicas a dirección qué pasó, por qué y qué hacer, sin jerga técnica. Proactividad : encuentras oportunidades que nadie te pidió buscar. Rigor analítico : tus conclusiones se sostienen con datos y método. Colaboración : trabajas de la mano con Paid Media, CRM, Comercial, BI, Producto y Negocio. ¿Por qué Vemo? El cambio lo activamos en equipo, y tu talento puede llevarnos más lejos. En Vemo, cada persona aporta experiencias, ideas y perspectivas que nos ayudan a resolver retos y construir mejores soluciones. Aquí queremos que puedas ser tú, compartir lo que sabes y descubrir nuevas formas de crecer. Promovemos un entorno de respeto, inclusión e igualdad de oportunidades. Valoramos a quienes se suman al equipo por sus habilidades y experiencia, sin discriminación por origen, raza, religión, nacionalidad, género, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad o cualquier otra condición. Trae tus ideas, suma tu talento y crece con nosotros.

Title: Marketing Analyst, New Business and M&A
Description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce. We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary: Toptal is looking for a Marketing Analyst to build and own the marketing data infrastructure to support new businesses and companies we acquire through M&A. The role is part of our Business Analytics Center of Excellence, where analysts are assigned to support one or more business functions. You will track paid advertising performance and translate it into metrics such as LTV and ROAS that inform budget allocation and channel strategy, from structuring the underlying data pipelines to developing the reports that help marketing and business leaders make data-driven decisions. Are you passionate about bringing rigor to how early-stage businesses measure and optimize acquisition spend from day one? If so, we encourage you to apply! This person will define the metrics that matter, measure channel and campaign performance, and develop reports that drive decisions. They will also build models, forecast outcomes, run experiments, and perform in-depth diagnostic analysis. Ultimate success goes beyond data-related activities, you’ll be delivering the “so what” that drives decisions and real business impact. It is imperative to fully understand each business (processes, objectives, organization, performance drivers, barriers), and connect the dots between paid acquisition data, marketing strategy, and financial and operational effectiveness. This role partners closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions, ensuring marketing performance insights are integrated with the broader business and revenue picture. We expect that we not only answer the question asked, but also the question that was not. This Marketing Analyst needs to build positive relationships across the organization, manage diverse stakeholders with competing and often conflicting priorities, and have a “find a way” attitude. This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. Analyze data, build models, test hypotheses, find root causes, develop prototypes, forecast performance, create Tableau reports, and write SQL scripts; and extract insights from these data activities to inform marketing decisions. Build, own, and maintain the marketing data infrastructure, from ad impression and click through lead acquisition to revenue, setting up and integrating Google Analytics, Google Ads, and other paid advertising platforms as required. Rapidly assess and integrate the marketing data of newly acquired (M&A) companies, establishing tracking, attribution, and reporting so their acquisition spend is measured with the same rigor as the rest of Toptal. Measure and diagnose paid advertising performance across channels and businesses—analyzing spend efficiency, CAC, funnel conversion, lead value, ROAS, and LTV—to guide budget allocation and channel strategy. Define metrics that are independent, holistic, accurate, encourage the right behaviors, and are aligned with company strategy and objectives, including consistent definitions of LTV, ROAS, and payback across businesses. Use descriptive (what happened) and diagnostic (why did it happen) analytics to develop specific, actionable recommendations for marketing leaders and business owners. Partner closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions to connect marketing performance with revenue, unit economics, and the broader business picture. Map marketing processes and channel journeys to their corresponding data flows across acquisition, engagement, and revenue generation. Proactively identify and surface opportunities to improve efficiency, conversion, revenue generation, client and talent experience, operations, communication, systems & tools, cash usage, etc. Leverage Generative AI tools to accelerate analysis and automate reporting workflows. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree is required. 3+ years of experience in data analysis, analytics, or business intelligence is required, with a focus on marketing analytics. Demonstrated experience analyzing paid advertising performance (e.g., Google Ads and other paid media platforms) and translating it into metrics such as LTV, CAC, and ROAS is required. Demonstrated experience building or owning marketing data infrastructure (tracking, attribution, data pipelines, and reporting) is required. Both a strong background in math, science, finance, engineering, or statistics and deep business insight is required; advanced degrees and/or MBA are a plus. Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Qlik, PowerBI, etc.). Proficiency in SQL; experience with R, Python, or MATLAB is a plus. Hands-on experience using Generative AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to support analysis, automation, and reporting. Description: Descripción de la empresa En Doctoralia , nuestra misión es humanizar la experiencia de la salud a través de la tecnología. Como la plataforma líder en el mercado mexicano y referente global en soluciones SaaS para el sector médico, conectamos a millones de pacientes con especialistas, transformando la práctica clínica en una experiencia digital eficiente y centrada en el paciente. La misión El/la AI & Transformation Manager es dueño del modelo operativo de Customer Success en Doctoralia México: define cómo se atiende al doctor a lo largo de su ciclo de vida —activación, adopción, farming, upsell y churn— y decide, journey por journey, qué resuelve un agente automatizado, qué se queda en manos de una persona y por qué. Su razón de ser es cambiar la relación entre el tamaño de la cartera y el tamaño del equipo: que atender a más doctores deje de exigir proporcionalmente más gente, sin degradar la calidad de la relación con el doctor. Responde por el resultado en retención y en costo de servir , no por la cantidad de herramientas lanzadas. Su marco de actuación es la operación de CS México y los sistemas que la ejecutan. Colabora con Producto, Tech, Revenue Operations, el equipo de venta de productos adicionales, los Key Account Managers y los equipos globales del grupo. No es un rol de ciencia de datos: no entrena modelos, construye y opera los sistemas con los que trabaja el área. Lo que harás Modelo operativo: mapear el ciclo de vida del doctor y decidir, journey por journey, qué resuelve la IA en primera instancia y qué escala a una persona. Rediseño de journeys: reconstruir onboarding, farming, upsell y churn alrededor de agentes, con puntos de intervención humana definidos de forma explícita. Mejora continua: el modelo nunca está terminado — actualizarlo conforme cambian producto, herramientas y mercado, y retirar lo que deja de servir. Causas raíz de churn: atacar falla de pago, onboarding fallido y flujos de churn rotos rediseñando el journey, usando la señal que el negocio ya produce. Construcción real: prototipar con LLM APIs, frameworks de agentes y workflows, automatización low-code y SQL. Probar valor en alcance acotado antes de pedir inversión de plataforma. Kraken: evolucionar el outreach automatizado de recordatorios por reglas a agentes capaces de sostener una conversación y resolver la tarea sin escalar a una persona. Instrumentación: definir qué significa éxito en cada campaña automatizada y cerrar la brecha de conversaciones sin evaluación de resultado. Escalamiento: llevar los prototipos a sistemas soportados junto con Producto, Tech, Revenue Operations y equipos globales. Build vs. buy: evaluar proveedores cuando comprar gana a construir, y decirlo con claridad cuando no. Adopción real: responder por el uso diario de las herramientas por parte de CS, el equipo de upsell y los Key Account Managers — no por los lanzamientos. Governance de IA: definir qué puede decidir un modelo solo, qué debe escuchar un doctor de una persona, y bajo qué criterios se construye, compra o mata una iniciativa. Privacidad de datos: garantizar que ningún dato personal o clínico entre a prompts, logs o sistemas de terceros sin base legal y revisión documentada. Liderazgo: dirigir y hacer crecer a tu equipo; presentar resultados, hipótesis y apuestas fallidas a leadership local y de grupo en números claros. Lo que buscamos Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en operaciones comerciales, Customer Success, Service Operations o Revenue Operations, en un negocio de suscripción o marketplace. Al menos 2 años liderando equipo directo. Experiencia comprobable construyendo con IA —no solo usándola—: LLM APIs, frameworks de agentes o workflows, diseño de prompts y de evaluación, con sistemas en producción e impacto medible. Inglés Avanzado Capacidad de leer un P&L y defender una línea de presupuesto ante Finanzas. Experiencia gestionando proyectos multifuncionales con stakeholders más senior, sin autoridad formal sobre ellos. Deseable: experiencia en SaaS, marketplace o salud. ¿Te interesa construir el modelo operativo de CS de una de las plataformas de salud más grandes de Latinoamérica? Postúlate o comparte esta vacante con alguien que encaje. 🚀
